name: Rasters for ALS metrics at 50m resolution
description: Raster models for 37 LiDAR-derived metrics over the PTPN 6 estate (Area 1), Batanghari regency (Area 2), Harapan rainforest protected area (Area 3), and Sarolangun regency (Area 4), in Jambi, Sumatra, Indonesia. Pixel size: 50m. Geographic Coordinate System: EPSG 32748.
